title: Nul-matrix-v1: code and data for the Null Matrix papers (2D and 3D lattice models of complex phase links)
description: Code and data for the preprints of the Null Matrix project. The 2D paper "Self-boiling lattice of complex links: finite domains, elastic coexistence and a massless gauge mode in a 2D toy model of cosmogenesis" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23838333): directories src/, data/, paper/. The 3D paper "Threshold, nucleation and disorder pinning in a chiral three-dimensional network of phase links with a conserved budget" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24599194): directory 3d/. See README for the quick test, figure scripts and run scripts.
